lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Your Grace,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I have a favor to ask.
You, asking a favor? I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I'm perfectly capable of asking for a favor

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: when I need something.
All right, then, what is it?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: May I borrow the pool for a day?
The one at the Outpost?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Exactly.
Why do you need to borrow the swimming pool there?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I want to set a certain mood.
Come again?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Do you remember the magnolia tea

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: we had last time?
The one we all drank together on the cruise ship?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I was reminiscing on our time there, and I had the tea again,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: but it didn't taste the same as when we drank it on the ship.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I was curious as to why that is,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: and I came to the conclusion perhaps it is because my surroundings are different.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Therefore, I want to recreate the atmosphere from that mission as much as possible.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Going all the way back up to the surface, and the ocean,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: would be too much of a hassle,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: so I was going to try having tea at the pool.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I also don't want to run into any other Nikkes,

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: so if you'd let me borrow it for a day, I would greatly appreciate it.
Shouldn't we invite everyone, though?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Excuse me?
If your goal is to recreate the atmosphere from our last mission, then you should invite all the people who were there.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: All of them?

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I just told you; I don't want to run into any other Nikkes.
I'll contact them.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: You're nothing if not persistent.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: dorothy_s
lines.text: I have plenty of tea leaves to spare anyway.
Okay. I'll check everyone's schedule and get back to you.
